title: Split large-index staging checks into witnessed bounded steps
failure_signature: A combined stage, manifest, review, diff, and status wrapper exceeded its three-minute process bound after writing invalid review receipts.
trigger_preconditions: multiple Git scans are composed in one wrapper
a failed early receipt requires repair
candidate_workaround: Run normalization, staging, manifest, exact review, and status summaries as separate bounded commands so each has a truthful exit status and retry boundary.
recurrence_guard: Do not combine repeated large-index scans after a known invalid receipt; bound and witness each lifecycle step separately.
rollback: Leave the index staged but uncommitted, inspect the last valid receipt, and do not claim completion.
scope_boundary: Staging cadence improves operational observability only; it is not independent reproduction or substantive validation.
